data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment
* **code_version:** ed2792c71457a45e494bf6b2d44859f4163acd46
* **scripts:** plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh (_phase_staged_intermediate PR1 wait), plugins/dso/scripts/wait-for-pr.sh
* **workflow:** .github/workflows/check-staged-head.yml (on: pull_request: branches:[main])
* **context:** /dso:sprint waxen-sigma — merge-to-main after closing the Phase A draft PR

### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** Release-pipeline blocker (two-channel staged promotion)

#### Expected Behavior
Per merge-to-main-pr.sh design comments (lines 748-764): PR1 (source->staged-*) requires ONLY review-sub-pr (sub-PR ruleset); check-staged-head is a PR2 (staged-*->main) requirement (main ruleset). So PR1's wait must not be blocked by check-staged-head.

#### Actual Behavior
PR1 (worktree-20260602-122923 -> staged-*) is declared a terminal failure on 'check-staged-head':
  "ERROR: PR1 #559 has failed required check(s): checks=check-staged-head"
Root cause chain:
1. sprint Phase A opened draft PR #556 (session -> main). check-staged-head.yml (on: pull_request branches:[main]) fired on PR #556 and FAILED (head 'worktree-*' != 'staged-*' pattern) — correct for a session->main PR, which should never exist in the two-channel model.
2. merge-to-main created the version-bump commit (ed2792c714) on the session branch WHILE #556 was still open, so check-staged-head ran on ed2792c714 and recorded a FAILED status permanently on that commit.
3. The user closed #556, but the recorded failed check-staged-head status on ed2792c714 persists.
4. merge-to-main PR1 (#558, then #559) reuses ed2792c714 as head. wait-for-pr.sh polls 'gh pr checks <pr>' which reports ALL checks on the head commit — including the stale failed check-staged-head — and exits non-zero. merge-to-main treats this as a PR1 terminal failure and refuses to advance to PR2.

#### Two contributing defects
(a) merge-to-main does not close/guard the Phase A draft session->main PR before creating the version-bump commit, allowing check-staged-head to contaminate the shared commit.
(b) wait-for-pr.sh / merge-to-main PR1 wait does not scope required checks to the PR1 set (review-sub-pr); it treats every reported check (incl. PR2-only check-staged-head) as blocking.

#### Suggested directions (not prescriptive)
- merge-to-main should close (or refuse to proceed with) an open session->main draft PR before the bump; OR create the bump commit only after that PR is closed.
- The PR1 wait should restrict to PR1's actually-required checks (review-sub-pr), ignoring statuses for checks not required by the staged-* ruleset.

### 5. Skills and Workflows
* Workaround that should work: rewrite the session head (reset to last work commit + let merge-to-main regenerate a fresh, uncontaminated version-bump commit) AFTER the draft PR is closed, so PR1's head has no check-staged-head status.
data.title: [merge-to-main two-channel]: stale check-staged-head status on shared session commit blocks PR1 (session->staged)
